protocol.scope: No optical solves, no new headline filter, no threshold selected against the paper 5%. Inspect retained variance at physical frequencies and a linear Nyquist-band decomposition. Source camera headlines remain unchanged.
protocol.boundaries_reason: Known source geometric periods and camera sample pitch. They are diagnostic boundaries, not a claim of the undocumented paper SMS1000 cutoff.
protocol.alias_decomposition: Full 1mm optical DFT, split at the rectangular camera Nyquist region abs(fx),abs(fy)<=1/(2*q); sample both components by the existing linear area integrator; remove the unchanged common periodic mask. Decomposition includes a finite-DFT periodic continuation assumption and is not a new physical antialiasing model.
